$comment: Dependency advisories that are knowingly accepted in arda-mfe.
scripts/check-vuln.mjs runs `bun audit --json` and fails on any advisory
that is not listed here. All four current entries are transitive: none is a
direct dependency, so none can be fixed here without a patch or an override
that would diverge from the upstream lockfile.
The gate refuses an entry without package, severity, scope, reason,
revisitWhen and reviewed, so an exception has to state what it is and when

accepted.reason: adm-zip is pulled in by the federation dts plugin, which only generates TypeScript declarations during `bun run build`. It is not in any bundle that reaches a browser, and the advisory needs a crafted zip extracted to a destination containing symlinks, which the plugin never does with untrusted input.
accepted.revisitWhen: @module-federation/vite ships a dts-plugin release that drops adm-zip, or adm-zip publishes the 0.6.1 fix

accepted.reason: Same dependency path as GHSA-vwc7-r8mq-g2x9. The advisory is a denial of service from a declared uncompressed size in the zip header, which requires the build step to extract a hostile archive. The inputs are the repository's own source files.
accepted.revisitWhen: the adm-zip entry above is resolved

accepted.reason: sharp is a devDependency reached through wrangler/miniflare, which run the Workers locally and in `wrangler dev`. The libheif issues affect image decoding of attacker-supplied files; nothing in this repository decodes an untrusted image at build or preview time, and the native module is never part of a browser bundle.
accepted.revisitWhen: wrangler or miniflare ships a release depending on sharp >= 0.35.4

accepted.scope: production path, not reachable with the current call pattern
accepted.reason: The one entry with a production dependency path, tracked deliberately. The advisory is a missing bounds check in uuid v3/v5/v6 when the caller supplies its own output buffer, which lets a write run past that buffer. Nothing in this repository calls uuid.v3, v5 or v6 with a caller-provided buffer: v4 is generated internally and the exceljs path does not use those versions with an external buffer. Re-check this if a hashing or namespaced-uuid helper is ever added.
accepted.revisitWhen: @ag-ui/client and exceljs both ship releases depending on uuid >= 11.1.1
